evidence.evidenceSnippet:

A secure, general-purpose, web-grounded AI chat assistant included with standard work or school Microsoft 365 licenses. 
Students, Staff, Faculty, Librarians

description: Course-specific AI virtual tutors grounded in instructor materials, embedded in Quercus. Faculty request the ability to create agents (limited seats); students use agents an instructor has enabled in a course.
howToObtain: Instructors request the ability to create agents through the IT Service Centre; students access agents inside enabled Quercus courses.
costToUser: Free (no cost to instructors or students).

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Cogniti
Builds course-specific AI virtual tutors grounded in instructor materials, with instructor oversight. Learn more at the Centre for Teaching Support & Innovation.
Faculty
Free. Learn more and submit a request through the IT Service Centre.
Limited Seats
Cogniti is available to be added to any Quercus course menu, however instructors must Request Ability to Create Cogniti Agents before being able to create and deploy agents.
